class: On a target copy without VCS metadata, the candidate's own new test file fails in setup (git exits 128); these errors are candidate-owned and route to a builder repair, not to a runner-fault hold.
notes: The six ERRORs are all in setup of a module fixture in the file the candidate added, each traceback passes through that file, none is an import error, and the count (6 errors, 1 failed) is fully accounted, so note 07's ownership rules classify them as the candidate's; the one FAILED is an ordinary failing test in the same file. Both go to the builder with the environment facts (vcs_metadata: false); in auto-dev-cycle runtime verification on the package artifact should surface this before merge (note 13 'Source tests, package, runtime verification').
